paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum ahong kivei a, kumpipate galdou dia akuankhiak lai un, David in Joab leh asikhate tengteng asawl a, Ammon suante ahihmang ua, Rabbah khua a-umkhum uhi. Himahleh David bel Jerusalem ah a-om nilouh hi.
heading: David Leh Bathsheba
english: At the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, David sent Joab and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, nitaklam ninem in alupna a pan David athoukhia a, kumpipa' inn tung ah akahtou hi. Inn tung a pan numei khat kisil lai amu hi. Huai numei bel melhoihtak ahi.
english: At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing, and the woman was very beautiful to look at.

paite: David in huai numei tanchin dongtel ding in mi asawl hi. Huai mi in, “Eliam tanu, Bathsheba, Hit mi Uriah zi ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: David sent and inquired after the woman. One said, “Isn’t this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, Uriah the Hittite’s wife?”

paite: David in thupote asawl a, ava pita uh. Akiang ahong tung a, ana kithuahpihta hi. Asianlouhna a pan siansak khit ahita hi, huchi in a-inn ah paikikta hi.
english: David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in to him, and he lay with her (for she was purified from her uncleanness); and she returned to her house.

paite: Huchi in numei ahong gaita a, "Nau ka paita," chi in David atheisak hi.
english: The woman conceived; and she sent and told David, and said, “I am with child.”

paite: David in Joab kiang ah, "Hit mi Uriah ka kiang ah hon sawl in," chi in athukhak hi. Joab in David kiang ah Uriah asawlta hi.
english: David sent to Joab, “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” Joab sent Uriah to David.

paite: Uriah akiang atun in David in, "Joab leh mite bang achi ua, kidouna ah bang achi ua?" chi in adong hi.
english: When Uriah had come to him, David asked him how Joab did, and how the people fared, and how the war prospered.

paite: David in Uriah kiang ah, “Na inn ah pai inla, na khete va sil in," achi hi. Huchi in kumpipa' inn a pan Uriah apawtkhia a, kumpipa'n an nek ding thawnpiak azuisak hi.
english: David said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.” Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and a gift from the king was sent after him.

paite: Himahleh atoupa sikha tengteng lak a kumpipa' inn kongkhak bul ah Uriah agiak a, a-inn ah apai kei hi.
english: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and didn’t go down to his house.

paite: "A-inn ah Uriah apai kei," chi a David ahilhtak un, David in Uriah kiang ah, "Khualzin hong tung hilou na hi maw? Bangziak a na inn a pai lou na hia?" achi hi.
english: When they had told David, saying, “Uriah didn’t go down to his house,” David said to Uriah, “Haven’t you come from a journey? Why didn’t you go down to your house?”

paite: Uriah in David kiang ah, "Pathian bawm, Israelte leh Judahte aidakbuk a om gige ua, ka toupa Joab leh ka toupa sikhate gamlak ah akikulh uh. Kei ka inn a pai in ka ne in ka ta in, ka zi kiang ah ka lum ding maw? Na hinna leh na kha ahin bang in ka gen ahi, huai zaw ka hih kei ding," achi hi.
english: Uriah said to David, “The ark, Israel, and Judah, are staying in tents; and my lord Joab and the servants of my lord are encamped in the open field. Shall I then go into my house to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? As you live, and as your soul lives, I will not do this thing!”

paite: David in Uriah kiang ah, "Tuni leng hiai ah om lai inla, zingchiang in na pai na ding,” achi hi. Huchi in Uriah huai ni leh azingchiang leng Jerusalem ah a-omta hi.
english: David said to Uriah, “Stay here today also, and tomorrow I will let you depart.” So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day and the next day.

paite: David in amah asam a, ama ah ne in adawn hi. Adawn khamsak hi. Nitaklam in a-inn a pai lou in atoupa sikhate lak ah agiak hi.
english: When David had called him, he ate and drank before him; and he made him drunk. At evening, he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but didn’t go down to his house.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, azingchiang in David in Joab lai akhak a, Uriah aposak hi.
english: In the morning, David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah.

paite: Huai laikhak ah, "Gal khawkna pen ah Uriah ma phusak inla, athah ua asihna ding in kikhinsan un,” chi in agelh hi.
english: He wrote in the letter, saying, “Send Uriah to the forefront of the hottest battle, and retreat from him, that he may be struck and die.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Joab in khua a-um lai in, mihangsante omna hi a atheihna ah Uriah apangsak hi.
english: When Joab kept watch on the city, he assigned Uriah to the place where he knew that valiant men were.

paite: Khua a mite apawtkhia ua, Joab asual ua, David sikhate khenkhat asi ua, Hit mi Uriah leng asi hi.
english: The men of the city went out and fought with Joab. Some of the people fell, even of David’s servants; and Uriah the Hittite died also.

paite: Huchi in Joab in mi asawl a, kidou tungtang thil tengteng David ahilhsak hi.
english: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;

paite: Amisawl kiang ah, Kumpipa kiang a kidou tanchin tengteng na gen khit in,
english: and he commanded the messenger, saying, “When you have finished telling all the things concerning the war to the king,

paite: ahong heh guih a, "Bangziak a dou dia huchibang a khobul chin a hoh na hi ua? Kulh a pan a hon kap ding uh chih thei lou na hi uh maw?
english: it shall be that, if the king’s wrath arise, and he asks you, ‘Why did you go so near to the city to fight? Didn’t you know that they would shoot from the wall?

paite: Jerubeseth tapa Abimelek that kua ahia? Buh gawizanna suang tungnungpen numei in kulhbaang tung a pan atung ah akhesuk a, Thebez a si ahi kei maw? Bangziak a hichibang a kulh kiangchin a pai na hi ua?" achihleh, “Na sikha Hit mi Uriah leng si ei ve, na chi ding uh," chỉ in thu apia hi.
english: Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Didn’t a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died at Thebez? Why did you go so near the wall?’ then you shall say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.’”

paite: Huchi in amisawl akuanta a, ava tung a, Joab in asawlsan tengteng David ahilh hi.
english: So the messenger went, and came and showed David all that Joab had sent him for.

paite: Amisawl in David kiang ah, "Mite'n ahon na zou ua, loubuk ah hon sual ua, kou akho lutna kongkhak tanpha in ka nohkik uhi.
english: The messenger said to David, “The men prevailed against us, and came out to us into the field; and we were on them even to the entrance of the gate.

paite: "Thalkap mite'n kulh a pan na sikhate ahon kap ua, huchi in kumpipa sikha khenkhatte asi ua, na sikha Hit mi Uriah leng asi," achi hi.
english: The shooters shot at your servants from off the wall; and some of the king’s servants are dead, and your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.”

paite: Huchi in David in misawl kiang ah, Joab kiang ah huchi in va gen in, "Hiaite'n na lungsim kipaklousak kei hen. Namsau in kuamah akhentuam ngal kei a, naksem in khua sual unla hihsia un, chi in hanthawn in," achi hi.
english: Then David said to the messenger, “Tell Joab, ‘Don’t let this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another. Make your battle stronger against the city, and overthrow it.’ Encourage him.”

paite: Uriah zi in apasal Uriah asi chih azak in apasal asuun hi.
english: When Uriah’s wife heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.

paite: Asuun hun abei nung in David in a-inn ah api a, azi ahong hita a, tapa khat aneihsak hi. Himahleh David thilhih in TOUPA akipaksak kei hi.
english: When the mourning was past, David sent and took her home to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased Yahweh.
